summary: Iter-20 targeted retest for the 4 fixes from iter-19 on the Courier KPI module. Backend: 15/15 pytest PASS (4 new PUT exclude_unset tests in test_courier_kpi_iter20.py + 11 iter19 regression). Frontend Playwright: (REG#1) Print from MANAGE / COMPARE / JET tabs — popup HTML now contains per-courier headings 'JET — 3 Hours KPI', 'Toll — 3 Hours KPI', 'StarTrack — 3 Hours KPI' AND a Comparison section, with NO 'No courier data available.' fallback. (REG#2) After saving a courier from Manage tab, activeTab remains 'manage' (data-state=active, ck-add-courier still visible) — user can immediately add another. Same for compare after fetchData refresh. (REG#3) 0 Radix DialogContent a11y console warnings; description text visible in Add/Edit courier and KPI Entry dialogs. (REG#4) PUT /couriers/{id}: body {} preserves all fields, body {color} only updates color, body {active:false/true} correctly toggles. (REG#5) forceMount confirmed — 10 chart canvases mounted in DOM but 0 visible on Manage tab (hidden via data-[state=inactive]:hidden), no visual overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: Cosmetic-only observation for Print: with forceMount, Chart.js still renders into 0-sized hidden canvases, so canvas.toDataURL() returns a valid-but-blank 'data:,' PNG for tabs the user never visited. Result: when the user clicks Print while on the Manage tab (without ever having viewed each per-courier tab), the per-courier HEADINGS appear (bug fixed) and comparison charts appear (they are on the compare tab which IS force-mounted and does render because Chart.js sees a non-zero container size in the compare panel), but the per-courier chart IMAGES in the popup may be blank. Observed image counts: MANAGE=2, COMPARE=6, JET=6 data-URLs. To make images always render, consider either (a) offscreen container that always keeps courier charts at fixed size, or (b) programmatically resize/reflow chart.js instances before capture. Non-blocking — headings + comparison satisfy the retest acceptance criteria and no 'No courier data available.' fallback is shown.
PUT /couriers/{id} exclude_unset fix is clean — verified by 4 new pytest cases and by the previous iter-19 test suite still passing.

activeTab exemption for 'manage'/'compare' in fetchData is straightforward and correctly stops the tab-switch when couriers list changes; no regression in the empty-state path (still switches to 'manage' when 0 couriers).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 4 targeted regressions; visual-only note on blank chart images from Manage tab (headings/comparison still work)

seed_data_creation: Created 3 UI couriers (JET/Toll/StarTrack) + 1 KPI entry on JET (2025-08 = 86.2/13.8/97.2/2.8), and pytest created 4x TEST_ITER20_* couriers. All soft-deleted at teardown (verified UI shows empty state at end of run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iter-19 defects (Print empty from non-courier tabs, activeTab reset on Manage/Compare, DialogDescription a11y, PUT overwriting fields to None) are now FIXED. Backend collections `couriers` and `courier_kpi_entries` still in use. Tests: /app/backend/tests/test_courier_kpi_iter19.py (11 tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_courier_kpi_iter20.py (4 tests). Frontend gotcha still valid: Chart.js canvases keep 0-size in inactive TabsContent even with forceMount, so per-courier chart IMAGES (not headings) may be blank in the popup when printing from Manage tab without ever visiting each courier tab. Recommend: if you want reliable image capture, add an offscreen fixed-size mount for print or trigger chart.resize() before toDataURL().
rca_of_the_issue: All 4 iter-19 root causes are addressed: (1) TabsContent now uses forceMount className='data-[state=inactive]:hidden' — canvases stay mounted so Print can find them; (2) fetchData() now exempts activeTab in ['manage','compare'] from the forced switch; (3) DialogDescription added to Add/Edit courier and KPI Entry dialogs — 0 Radix warnings in console; (4) update_courier() uses payload.dict(exclude_unset=True) so unset fields are never written.
